existing.title: Region A Traefik reload burst alerts resolved on 28 October 2026
existing.summary: Grafana reported more than 10 Traefik configuration reloads in 15 minutes across nomad-hst02 through nomad-hst01. Alerts began at 01:21:20 UTC on 28 October 2026 for nomad-hst03, nomad-hst04 and nomad-hst01, and at 01:23:20 UTC for nomad-hst02 and nomad-hst05. All five alerts resolved at 01:31:20 UTC. The cause and any application impact remain unconfirmed.
